target.title: improve(matrix): prove lifecycle parity across substrates
target.body:
Closes #101054

## What Problem This Solves

Matrix QA needs one lifecycle contract for cold start, idempotent start, restart, stop, and resume so the same behavioral scenarios can run against both the Docker-backed Tuwunel reference server and Crabline's in-process Matrix transport adapter.

## Why This Change Was Made

The architecture is intentionally split into three layers:

1. `lifecycle.ts` owns only substrate-neutral state transitions and assertions. It knows that a runtime has a `baseUrl`, but knows nothing about Tuwunel or Crabline.
2. `tuwunel-lifecycle.runtime.ts` is the only production substrate wrapper added here. It adapts the existing Tuwunel harness and preserves its resolved port across restart/resume.
3. Crabline-specific behavior remains in `@openclaw/crabline`'s existing OpenClaw QA transport adapter. The real E2E test consumes only `startOpenClawCrablineAdapter({ channel: "matrix" })`, `probe()`, and `createInbound()`; qa-matrix contains no production Crabline implementation or policy.

The lifecycle contract permits a substrate to return a new endpoint after restart, while proving the replaced endpoint is no longer reachable. The same five scenarios and Matrix differential probe then run against both substrates.

## User Impact

No end-user Matrix runtime behavior or configuration changes. Maintainers gain executable lifecycle parity proof without duplicating Crabline transport ownership inside OpenClaw.

## Evidence

- Exact pushed head: `90c0a47ad0cb25dec1be5aaf3bac54c1b59ea1d4`.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwwcjc6fhmx62ma77m9p3m9n`: both real substrates passed all five lifecycle scenarios; shared unit tests passed.
- The focused extension changed gate passed production/test typechecks, changed-file lint, dependency pins, package guards, database-first guard, runtime sidecar guard, deadcode, and import-cycle checks.
- Production boundary check: `extensions/qa-matrix` has zero Crabline references outside tests; the refactor deletes the 129-line custom Crabline lifecycle module.
- Direct upstream contract inspection: Crabline `0.1.9` owns `startOpenClawCrablineAdapter`, Matrix provider probing, Matrix manifest/config translation, and adapter-owned inbound injection.
- Fresh autoreview thread `019f38d4-96e1-7910-a4b5-0e0d80d2ae2d` completed with no accepted or actionable findings after two earlier architecture findings were fixed.
- Warning-only known annotation: the real E2E uses an explicit `mkdtemp` cleanup path because Tuwunel writes container-owned files.

Developed with AI assistance. A sanitized agent transcript is available but is not included without explicit approval.
